title: Bitcoin & Crypto Rebound: Key Levels to Watch on BTC, ETH & XRP
description:
In this episode of Pro Charts: Crypto, pro trader Elizabeth Copeland breaks down the technical outlook for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP — covering both weekly and daily charts to give you a macro-to-micro read on where crypto may be headed next.

What's covered:

Bitcoin: Head & shoulders pattern, key resistance at $85K, and levels to watch for a potential reversal or continuation

XRP: Downsloping trend line breakout setup and what a confirmed break could mean for bulls

Ethereum: Bear flag at chart lows, parallel channel trade, and why patience may pay off for longer-term holders

Whether you're a day trader looking for intraday setups or a swing trader planning your next move, Elizabeth maps out both aggressive and conservative entry strategies for each asset.

🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell so you never miss a market update!
💬 Are you a short-term crypto trader or long-term hodler? Let us know in the comments!

#XRP #BTC #ETH #HeadAndShoulders #TechnicalAnalysis
